scope: 126 Chef Sui recipes from the preceding ingredient import
method: Compared every Chinese ingredient list and cooking method against saved video end-card OCR; visually checked selected critical discrepancies against original frames. Corrected passages translated into English and French. This is a source-consistency audit, not a cooking trial or a verification of every statement in full-length videos.
